# Captain SOP
[italic]Below outlines expectations and permissions granted to a Captain given the current alert level:[/italic]
[bold][color=green] Code Green [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] The Captain is [bold]not[/bold] permitted to perform regular Security Duty. If [color=#cb0000]Security[/color] is determined to be understaffed, or if a crime is actively being committed Captain may preform Security Duties.
[bold]2.[/bold] The Captain is [bold]not[/bold] permitted to take armor, weapons, or contraband from the Armory, unless authorized by the [color=#cb0000]Head of Security[/color].
[bold]3.[/bold] The Captain must have the Nuclear Authentication Disk (NAD) on their person or, in the possession of the [color=#cb0000]Head of Security[/color].
[bold]4.[/bold] The Captain is not to leave the Station. The exception to this is during shift end or early EVAC.
[bold]5.[/bold] The Captain may fire any [color=#1b67a5]Head of Staff[/color] given reasonable justification. Criminal activity, or endangering Crew, Station, or Nanotrasen as a whole are examples of reasonable justification.
[bold]6.[/bold] Departments lacking a [color=#1b67a5]Head of Staff[/color], should be assigned an [color=#1b67a5]Acting Head of Staff[/color] by the Captain, if qualified personnel are able to fill the position. The [color=#1b67a5]Acting Head of Staff[/color] [bold]must[/bold] be a member of the Department. While a [color=#1b67a5]Head of Staff[/color] for every department is not a strict requirements, it is expected the Captain will make an attempt to find a suitable [color=#1b67a5]Acting Head of Staff[/color].
[bold][color=blue] Code Blue [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] All guidelines carry over from Code Green.
[bold][color=RED] Code Red [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] All guidelines carry over from Code Blue.
[bold]2.[/bold] The Captain must ensure the communication of threats to the crew either via announcement console or through department heads.
